title: Neptune Apex Reading Status Mix
dataSources: Reef-tank parameters (`reeftank:param`), vivarium climate (`vivarium:climate`), fish feeder (`fishfeeder:event`), auto-doser (`doser:event`), auto-top-off (`ato:event`), pond sensors (`pondsensor:reading`).
app: Aquarium and vivarium controllers — reef-tank parameter monitors, auto-dosers, auto-top-off, reptile terrarium climate/UVB, and pond sensors — via MQTT and controller APIs (Apex, GHL, ESPHome).
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=neptune:apex
| eval status_value=lower(coalesce(probe_status,"unknown"))
| stats count as events by status_value
| sort - events
description: Breaks down the current mix of states reported by the Neptune Apex reading feed.
value: A status-mix panel provides quick at-a-glance context before you investigate specific outliers.
implementation: Map the source's `probe_status` values into a small set of clear labels and chart the resulting counts.
visualization: Donut or bar chart of event count by status.
grandmaExplanation: It scans the overall mood of your Neptune Apex reading feed by counting how many events are healthy, warning, or bad.
